policies.evaluation_role: previously inspected development months; not a new independent test
policies.schedule: validation end = calendar month start at/before evaluation_start - 60 days; preceding 3 complete months
policies.fit: one model before earliest validation month; training approvals end another 60 days earlier; labels strictly before fit time
policies.validation: only delivery labels strictly before evaluation_start; each calendar month must contain both classes
policies.threshold: every_month_floor: minimum of each month highest recall-feasible threshold, common score >= threshold
policies.selection: validation alerts then FP then AP then fixed candidate order; recent_month uses latest month, other strategies use all 3
policies.matched_comparison: all three strategies share training rows, fitted pipelines and scores within each fold/candidate
policies.recency_cost: 3-month validation requires older and fewer training orders; old single-month experiment is context only
policies.features: static or route_promise_90d; prior completed events strictly before each approval; no evaluation outcome input
policies.overlap: folds reuse historical calendar months; earlier evaluation can be later validation; not independent experiments
policies.recall_guarantee: validation monthly recall floor does not guarantee evaluation or future recall
policies.promotion: research artifacts only; original and balanced defaults unchanged

summary.note: same evaluation orders; training/validation cohorts and feature sets may differ

previous_single_month_context.note: same evaluation orders, different training/validation dates and row counts

split.maturity_scope: Maturity exclusions are within the existing valid delivered cohort only; they are not coverage estimates for all approved orders.
split.recency_tradeoff: Three full validation months move the training cutoff earlier than a single-month validation, changing training size and recency.
split.evaluation_role: retrospective development backtest; never model or threshold selection

approval_cohort_audit.scope: Raw orders with non-null approval timestamps, using the same approval cohorts; status counts describe the supplied raw table, not status as of a historical cutoff. Cancelled, unknown and other excluded orders receive no inferred delivery label. No dataset snapshot date is assumed.

threshold_policy.objective: minimize validation alert count subject to recall >= min_recall
threshold_policy.tie_policy: highest feasible observed threshold; all equal scores receive the same prediction
threshold_policy.evaluation_note: Validation recall does not guarantee recall on evaluation or future orders
